koreader.description:
KOReader is a free, open-source ebook and document reader designed for Android, E Ink devices, and desktop Linux. It supports a wide range of formats, including EPUB, PDF, DjVu, FB2, MOBI, CBZ, TXT, HTML, and more.

Enjoy a highly customizable reading experience with adjustable fonts, margins, spacing, contrast, text reflow, and multilingual hyphenation. Advanced features include dictionary lookups, Wikipedia searches, bookmarks, annotations, highlights, reading statistics, and flexible document navigation.

KOReader integrates with calibre, OPDS catalogs, Wallabag, WebDAV, and other services for discovering, transferring, and managing reading material. Reading progress can be synchronized between compatible KOReader devices, and plugins provide additional functionality.

Its interface is optimized for E Ink displays, with minimal animations and specialized controls for reading PDFs, comics, and scanned documents. KOReader is maintained by a community of volunteers and distributed under an open-source license.

Reading locally stored books does not require an account. Network-based integrations require connectivity, and Android users must install the APK compatible with their device's CPU architecture.
